text.description_html:
Laurey 38366, Oil Rubbed Bronze 4-3/4 Inch Highline Cabinet Pull

The Highline Cabinet Pull measures 4-3/4 inches overall and has mounting holes located at 3 inch center to center as well as 4 inch center to center. Each cabinet pull comes packaged with the mounting screws. The Adjustable Center to Center Highline Oil Rubbed Bronze Cabinet Pull has a transitional style that is sure to catch eyes and turn heads. This unique drawer pull can be used on kitchen cabinets, on dressers or other furniture, and in the bathroom as vanity hardware.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Highline Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 38366 Kitchen Cabinet Highline Pull in Oil Rubbed Bronze:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Length c.c. (center to center): Adjustable 3" or 4"
  • Overall Length: 4-3/4"
  • Width: 7/8"
  • Projection: 5/8"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
